page: Microsoft Azure D128ads_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor built on x86_64 architecture. The server provides 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical cores running at clock speeds up to 4.5 GHz, supported by 512 GB of RAM adhering to a standard 4 GB per vCPU distribution. Architectural features include 32 MB of L3 cache, hardware multithreading, and extensive instruction support including AVX-512, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Integrated hardware includes 7,559 GB of local NVMe SSD storage alongside Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization and Premium Storage support. Benchmark data reflects high data transfer capacity, logging 389.75 GB/sec large-block read memory bandwidth and 188.06 GB/sec write bandwidth, accompanied by a PassMark memory score of 2,974.31.

Computational benchmarks position the instance in the top tier of its class, recording a stress-ng multi-core metric of 233,122.22 and a PassMark CPU score of 133,871.81. Data processing tests show 177.38 million Redis SET operations per second and 107.2 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. CPU-driven LLM inference delivers 68.48 tokens per second on 7B models. Without discrete GPUs, this resource density is tailored for enterprise relational databases, large-scale caching layers, and high-concurrency web tiers.
description: Microsoft Azure D128ads_v7 is a high-density general-purpose virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked up to 4.5 GHz. The system provides 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical cores, 512 GB of system memory, and 7,559 GB of bundled NVMe SSD local storage. Operating without discrete graphics acceleration, it relies on x86_64 instruction extensions including AVX-512 and VAES to accelerate computational and cryptographic throughput. In standardized benchmarks, the instance demonstrates top-tier multi-core execution with a stress-ng score of 233,122.22 and sustained large-block memory read bandwidth of 389.75 GB/sec. Database and caching workloads register exceptional throughput, yielding over 177 million Redis SET operations per second. With its balanced 4 GB RAM per vCPU ratio and substantial integrated solid-state capacity, the D128ads_v7 offers a consolidated, cost-efficient compute environment for enterprise relational databases, large in-memory caches, high-concurrency web tiers, and multi-threaded analytical pipelines.
